_meta.note: Recommended Module2 PPO v2 training parameters. NOT training authorization: remote formal runs still require an approved/frozen v2 Research Contract (hard rule #20). Values below override train_rl_rs_ppo.py argparse defaults, which are kept at v1 for reproducibility.

changes_vs_v1.total_timesteps: 100k -> 500k (on-policy PPO without HER needs 5-10x the off-policy budget; TQC+HER parking converges at 100k)
changes_vs_v1.rollout: n_envs 1 -> 8, n_steps 128 -> 256 (rollout buffer 128 -> 2048, community-standard scale), batch_size 64 -> 256, n_epochs 4 -> 10
changes_vs_v1.features_extractor (lane A): 21-dim hand-pooled summary -> full-patch CNN (fixes geometry blindness behind collision-dominated failures)
changes_vs_v1.value_pretrain (lane B): critic pretraining under frozen BC actor before PPO (JSRL Fig.2: random critic destroys warm-started actor)

lane_b_summary_warm_start_fixed._note: learning-rate lowered to 1e-4 to protect the BC prior during early PPO updates (offline-to-online fine-tuning practice).
